events.summary: Hello again ✨Welcome to part two of our devlog catch-up! In our last post, we talked about the core loop and gem processing. Today, we want to show you what we have been doing to bring the world itself to life.🛠️ New NPCs for Tools You need good equipment to mine the best stones. Instead of buying upgrades from a standard menu, we added new NPCs to the town who specifically sell tools.
